description: Get a Stripe checkout link for a one-time credit pack, to hand to the user. Packs: `starter` $9 for 500 credits, `growth` $29 for 2,000 credits, `scale` $99 for 10,000 credits. Credits never expire; 1 credit per document. If this server has an API key set, the credits land on that key's account. Without a key, pass the user's `email` (ask them; do not invent one) — the page after payment shows their new API key. Creating the link charges nothing; the user pays on Stripe's page.

email.description: The user's email. Required only when no API key is set on this server; ignored when one is.

name: buy_credits
title: Buy a credit pack (returns a checkout link)
